e1.inputs: Exact frozen P2 image, CoC, CNL and candidates; no demonstrations or task-specific training
e1.decoding: Greedy, 12 new tokens, unchanged unique-option parser; invalid responses retained
e1.seeds: One deterministic generation, not three duplicated inference seeds

e2.initialization: Same pretrained base and seeded fresh LoRA initialization for every arm; no historical temporal adapters
e2.rule_availability: Arm-specific rule availability at both training and evaluation; additional common-rule evaluation reported separately
e2.loss: Assistant-only token cross entropy + lambda * (-log(sum of conditional A-D probabilities of admissible labels))
e2.semantic_scope: Categorical adaptation inspired by Xu et al. (ICML 2018); not a reproduction of their Bernoulli-output experiments
e2.semantic_probabilities: FP32 softmax over A-D logits at the first assistant label position; no reference label in admissibility mask
e2.admissibility: Independent integer rules evaluated only to construct training masks and to score held-out predictions; no oracle filtering during decoding
e2.checkpoint: Fixed final epoch, no validation or test selection
e2.hyperparameters: lambda=1 fixed before execution; no test-driven tuning

grouping: Task, rule duration and input encoding; no pooling of correlated variants as independent scenes
interpretation: Without the rule, identical inputs can have different reference labels; report empirical input-identifiability ceiling
Low violation alone can reflect conservative lower-progress selections; always report accuracy and paired correctness
Semantic loss constrains conditional A-D mass, not the full generated language; invalid outputs remain possible
Fresh position-hold fits differ from historical continuation fits; do not claim matched historical initialization
Only synthetic candidate selection; no trajectory generation, independent road-scene or runtime safety guarantee
An 8B success or failure is evidence for these frozen tasks, not a universal necessity or sufficiency of training
